OpenTelemetry ​

Agent SDK sends traces, metrics, and logs to an OTLP collector when you set the OTEL_* variables. Record your own with @opentelemetry/api.

bash
export OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=https://otel.example.com
export OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS="Authorization=Bearer%20$OTEL_TOKEN"
export OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=incident-agent
agent-sdk serve --dir . --dev
  • The default protocol is http/protobuf. http/json also works, and grpc logs a warning and falls back to http/protobuf.
  • Metrics use delta temporality. Grafana Cloud and Prometheus reject delta, so set OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_TEMPORALITY_PREFERENCE=cumulative when you export to either one.
  • If you don't set an endpoint, Agent SDK doesn't export anything.
  • You can create a meter, tracer, or logger at the top of bot/agent.ts, and it will use Agent SDK's providers.

Variables ​

VariableEffect
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINTBase URL. Appends /v1/traces, /v1/metrics, /v1/logs.
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINTTraces URL, used as written. Overrides the base URL.
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_ENDPOINTMetrics URL, used as written. Overrides the base URL.
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_ENDPOINTLogs URL, used as written. Overrides the base URL.
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERSSent on every export. URL-encode values. Reread on each export.
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOLhttp/protobuf (default) or http/json.
OTEL_SERVICE_NAMEservice.name. Defaults to the agent name, then unknown_service:node.
OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTESservice.namespace, service.version, deployment.environment.name.
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_TEMPORALITY_PREFERENCEdelta (default), cumulative, or lowmemory.
OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTERotlp exports logs. Unset, none, and console do not.
OTEL_SDK_DISABLEDtrue turns export off.
OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTERnone turns traces off.
OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTERnone turns metrics off.
OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS1 adds prompt text to log records.
OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT1 adds tool payloads to log records.
AGENT_SDK_OTEL_SEMCONVTrace format: legacy (default), standard, or both. See Trace format.
OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENTtrue or span_only adds prompts, replies, and tool payloads to standard and both spans.

Trace format ​

By default, Agent SDK names its spans agent_sdk.turn, agent_sdk.tool, and agent_sdk.subagent, and keys them with agent_sdk.* and cursor.* attributes. Observability tools that read the OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions don't recognize those names. Set AGENT_SDK_OTEL_SEMCONV to send spans they can map without a custom mapper.

ValueSpan namesAttributes
legacy (default)agent_sdk.turn, agent_sdk.tool, agent_sdk.subagentagent_sdk.* and cursor.*, unchanged
standardinvoke_agent <agent>, execute_tool <tool>, invoke_agent <subagent>gen_ai.* where a GenAI key exists, agent_sdk.* for the rest
bothSame as legacyEvery legacy and every standard key

An unknown value logs a warning and keeps legacy.

The format changes turn, tool, and subagent spans, and the conversation id key on spans you start during a turn. Turn phase spans keep their agent_sdk.turn.<phase> names. Span events, HTTP and MCP spans, metrics, and log records are the same in every format.

Attribute mapping ​

legacystandardSpan
(none)gen_ai.operation.name: invoke_agent or execute_toolturn, subagent, tool
cursor.conversation.id, agent_sdk.session_idgen_ai.conversation.idall
agent_sdk.agentgen_ai.agent.nameturn, tool
agent_sdk.subagent_namegen_ai.agent.namesubagent
agent_sdk.subagent_descriptiongen_ai.agent.descriptionsubagent
(none)gen_ai.request.modelturn
agent_sdk.finish_reason on message.completed eventsgen_ai.response.finish_reasonsturn
agent_sdk.usage.input_tokensgen_ai.usage.input_tokensturn
agent_sdk.usage.output_tokensgen_ai.usage.output_tokensturn
agent_sdk.usage.cache_read_tokensgen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokensturn
agent_sdk.usage.cache_write_tokensgen_ai.usage.cache_creation.input_tokensturn
agent_sdk.usage.reasoning_tokensgen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokensturn
cursor.tool.namegen_ai.tool.nametool
agent_sdk.call_idgen_ai.tool.call.idtool
agent_sdk.tool_argsgen_ai.tool.call.argumentstool
agent_sdk.tool_outputgen_ai.tool.call.resulttool
agent_sdk.tool_error_classerror.typetool
cursor.tool.status, cursor.tool.kindDropped. A failed tool has error.type and an error status.tool

Every other attribute keeps its name. gen_ai.input.messages, gen_ai.output.messages, gen_ai.request.model, gen_ai.response.finish_reasons, and error.type appear only in standard and both.

Your trace tags follow the same table in standard and both. A tag that names the conversation, the agent, the turn, or the tool call is dropped so it can't replace the runtime's value: cursor.conversation.id, agent_sdk.session_id, agent_sdk.agent, agent_sdk.subagent_name, agent_sdk.turn_id, agent_sdk.call_id, cursor.tool.name, and their gen_ai.* counterparts. In legacy, trace tags are copied as written.

error.type is a short class on any span that ends in error:

  • On a turn, the runner's error code, cancelled, or _OTHER.
  • On a tool, auth_required, denied, not_found, rate_limited, timeout, unauthorized, or tool_error, and incomplete when the turn ended before the tool returned.
  • On a subagent, _OTHER, or incomplete when the turn ended first.

gen_ai.request.model is the model the turn asked for. A model fallback doesn't change it.

Message content ​

Spans carry no prompts, replies, or tool payloads unless you opt in, in any format.

Settinglegacystandard and both
OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT=trueNothinggen_ai.input.messages, gen_ai.output.messages, gen_ai.tool.call.arguments, gen_ai.tool.call.result, gen_ai.agent.description
OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=otlp and OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS=1Log records onlyAlso gen_ai.input.messages
OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=otlp and OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT=1agent_sdk.tool_args, agent_sdk.tool_outputThe same payloads under the keys of the format

span_only and span_and_event work like true. false, no_content, and event_only add nothing, because Agent SDK doesn't emit GenAI events. gen_ai.input.messages holds the turn's user prompts, and gen_ai.output.messages holds its final reply. Agent SDK cuts each text to 2,048 characters. gen_ai.tool.call.arguments and gen_ai.tool.call.result hold the payload as JSON. A payload longer than 2,048 characters becomes a JSON string of its first 2,048 characters, so every value still parses.

Move a dashboard to standard ​

  1. Set AGENT_SDK_OTEL_SEMCONV=both and redeploy. Existing dashboards keep working, and every span gains its gen_ai.* keys.
  2. Rewrite queries with the mapping table, for example cursor.conversation.id to gen_ai.conversation.id, and connect your vendor's GenAI view.
  3. Queries on span names don't move in both. In standard, filter on gen_ai.operation.name instead of agent_sdk.turn or agent_sdk.tool.
  4. Set AGENT_SDK_OTEL_SEMCONV=standard once nothing reads the legacy keys.

On a hosted agent, add AGENT_SDK_OTEL_SEMCONV to hosting.secretNames and set it with agent-sdk secret set like the other variables.

Hosted agents ​

ts
export default defineAgent({
  hosting: {
    egressDomains: ["otlp-gateway-prod-us-east-0.grafana.net"],
    secretNames: [
      "OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT",
      "OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS",
      "OTEL_SERVICE_NAME",
    ],
  },
});

service.name is fixed by the first export, so redeploy to change it.

Record and tag ​

ts
import { metrics, trace } from "@opentelemetry/api";
import { logs } from "@opentelemetry/api-logs";
import { currentConversationId } from "@grok/agent-sdk/otel";

const tracer = trace.getTracer("incident-agent");
const lookups = metrics.getMeter("incident-agent").createCounter("incident.lookups");
const logger = logs.getLogger("incident-agent");

lookups.add(1, { "cursor.conversation.id": currentConversationId() });

Spans started during a turn get cursor.conversation.id (gen_ai.conversation.id in the standard trace format, both keys in both), and a metric gets it only when you set it.

To tag a whole turn, call ctx.telemetry from a tool. Spans in the turn get the trace keys, Agent SDK's log records get the log keys, and cursor.token.usage gets the metric keys. Outside a tool, use telemetry from @grok/agent-sdk/telemetry.

ts
async execute({ key }, ctx) {
  ctx.telemetry.setTraceAttributes({ "work.item": key });
  ctx.telemetry.setMetricAttributes({ "work.item": key });
  ctx.telemetry.setLogAttributes({ "work.item": key });
  return await jira.getIssue(key);
}

Grafana renames a . in a metric key to _.

promql
sum by (work_item) (cursor_token_usage_total)
  • Each distinct metric value is a new series, so never use a per-turn ID, a secret, an email, or a raw user ID.
  • A session holds up to 32 keys of each kind, with keys up to 128 characters and values up to 256.

Limits ​

  • Agent SDK doesn't support custom span processors, samplers, views, your own OpenTelemetry SDK, or library auto-instrumentation. It reads OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER and OTEL_METRIC_EXPORT_INTERVAL once at startup, so restart the process after you change either one.
  • Import Agent SDK before any other OpenTelemetry setup. Otherwise the turn's tags may not reach your spans.

Migrating from serve({ otel }) ​

Delete serve({ otel }), bot/otel.ts, bot/instrumentation.ts, and any defineOtel call. Set these variables instead.

Old optionSet this instead
serviceNameOTEL_SERVICE_NAME
serviceVersionservice.version in OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES
resourceAttributesOTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES, comma-separated, URL-encoded values
exporters[].urlOTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT (appends /v1/traces, /v1/metrics, /v1/logs)
exporters[].url with signalsOTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_ENDPOINT, or OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_ENDPOINT, used as written
exporters[].headersOTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS, comma-separated, URL-encoded values
exporters[].protocolOTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL, or OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_PROTOCOL, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_PROTOCOL, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_PROTOCOL
exporters[].signalsThe per-signal URL. OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=none, OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER=none, or OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=none stops that signal.
traces: falseOTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=none
traces: trueLeave OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER unset. Traces start when an endpoint is set.
traces.sampleRatioOTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=parentbased_traceidratio and OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG, before process start
metrics: falseOTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER=none
metrics: trueLeave OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER unset. Metrics start when a metrics URL is set.
metrics.exportIntervalMillisOTEL_METRIC_EXPORT_INTERVAL, milliseconds, before process start
logs: falseUnset OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER, or set none
logs: trueOTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=otlp
logs.userPromptsOTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=otlp and OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS=1
logs.toolContentOTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=otlp and OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT=1
otel: falseNo endpoint, or OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true

Set the hosted values after deploy:

bash
agent-sdk secret set my-agent OTEL_SERVICE_NAME OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS
